metadata.title: Scanning tunneling microscopy of pentacene monolayers on Cu(111)

affiliations.name: Institute of Experimental Physics, University of Innsbruck, Technikerstrasse 25, 6020 Innsbruck, Austria

metadata.description: We report scanning tunneling microscopy and atomic force microscopy measurements of pentacene monolayers grown on Cu(111) under ultra-high vacuum. Images acquired at 4 K resolve the molecular orbital structure and reveal two coexisting ordered phases. Raw scans for all imaging conditions are included.

mc_references.ref_citation: N. Aliyeva, Ordered phases of pentacene on Cu(111) imaged at 4 K, Surface Science 748, 122601 (2026), 10.1016/j.susc.2026.122601
